title: S11T04 - Harden generated artifact tracking and ignore policy
description: Resolve how generated Boreal files should appear in git status across repos so ledgers/runtime/index artifacts do not create recurring false alarms.
acceptanceCriteria: .boreal/ledgers, .boreal/runtime, memory/raw/index.jsonl, result spools, and installed skill artifacts each have an explicit track/ignore policy.
Policies are enforced or checked during init, sync refresh, doctor, and package smoke tests where applicable.
Unexpected untracked generated paths produce targeted repair guidance instead of a generic unhealthy git state.
closedReason: Artifact policy accepted: generated paths and memory/raw/index.jsonl have explicit classification and repair guidance.
